Definition: from G3501 and a derivative of G5453; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.
BiblicalUsage: A bishop must not be a novice, a new convert lifted up with pride, lest he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning is for the newly planted: pride grows fastest in fresh soil, and the novice who is lifted up too soon falls the hardest.
